request.style: English, warm female solo voice, acoustic guitar, cello, soft piano, ambient pads, gentle flute, serene and reflective, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I have not turned away from your judgments
For you yourself have taught me the way
How sweet your promise is to my taste
Sweeter than honey in my mouth
From your precepts I gain understanding
I hate every path of falsehood

[Chorus]
Your word is a lamp to my feet
A light on my path in the night
Guiding my steps with divine grace
Shining through the darkness deep

[Verse]
I have sworn an oath and confirmed it
To keep your righteous judgments true
I have been afflicted beyond measure
LORD give me life according to your word
Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth
And teach me your judgments again

[Chorus]
Your word is a lamp to my feet
A light on my path in the night
Guiding my steps with divine grace
Shining through the darkness deep

[Bridge]
Sweet honey flows into my heart
Understanding grows from your precepts
Falsehood fades in the bright light
Your truth remains forever sure

[Outro]
Your word is a lamp to my feet
A light on my path in the night
